pictures.author: AlChtzn
pictures.observations: Whole daylight pair: eastern octagonal brick body/rounded corner shafts, tall pointed blind panels, intricate upper bands, shallow segmented roof with real lower openings. Western tower behind has restrained panel ornament and visible stabilizing struts.

pictures.author: Moosavipour140
pictures.observations: Western masonry detail: pointed panel, raised brick herringbone/stepped patterns, geometric upper band. Use original restrained brick bars/lozenges, not traced inscriptions or photo pixels.

pictures.author: Soroush R1998
pictures.observations: Newer ordinary night photograph contains both complete towers. Confirms shallow curved caps/open lower cap slots, actual rounded corner shafts, tall pointed blind panels, small eastern ground portal, upper patterned brick belt and western stabilizing members. Night colors are not copied as daylight material colors.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific paired Kharaqan mausoleums at one archaeological site: two separate mapped octagonal brick masses/rounded corner shafts, tall recessed pointed fields, original broad geometric brick relief and upper friezes, shallow curved brick caps with real lower slots. Distinguish the more ornate eastern panels from the western panels and restrained stabilizing struts. Small separate grade-seated brick footings; no platform across the gap or entire archaeological-site replacement. No copied inscriptions, image atlas, furnished tomb chambers or restored perfect sealed roofs.
